title: Face Sculpt Era #070 (멕시코 · 20대 · 컨셉 메이크업 · 칼라베라(망자의 날) · 정면 · 유형 고유 메이크업 · 귀만 피어싱 · 귀 추 8개/귀 2구멍 · 헤나)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Mexican woman, mid 20s, with a signature Day of the Dead sugar-skull glamour makeup look — a strong, beautiful, symmetrical face with a warm medium-tan complexion, high cheekbones and a straight nose. Hair: long, thick, glossy black hair parted in the center with a crown of orange marigold and red flowers sitting on top of the head, falling past the shoulders but tucked behind both ears, leaving both ears fully visible. Her eyes: eyes ringed with black painted circles shaped like the eye sockets of a sugar skull, decorated with delicate white, red and gold flower petals and fine dotted lines radiating outward, long dark lashes, a calm, mysterious gaze. Her brows: eyebrows painted into slender black swirls with small white dots. Her lips: lips painted black with fine white stitch lines drawn vertically across them like a skull's teeth, softly closed. A pale white painted base across the forehead and cheeks with intricate black and coloured flower, swirl and dot designs on the forehead, nose and chin, the painted lines sharp and neat, real skin visible through the thin paint. Real skin with visible fine pores, soft natural peach fuzz and a gentle sheen of natural oils on her face, ears and neck, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Every feature is beautiful, balanced and refined, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: Only the ears are pierced, and nowhere else on the face: on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe. The left and right sides are balanced. Her lips, nose, eyebrows, chin, forehead, temples and cheeks carry no piercing at all, so the shape of her lips stays completely clear and unobstructed. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these two iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly eight separate massive solid weights, each of a different shape: on the left ear a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links; on the right ear a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links. On each ear the two iron rings each carry their own column of weights, the two columns holding 4 and 4 weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is an enormous, dense, completely solid, squat, blunt lump of rough black cast iron, as big as a fist or larger, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the long chains reaching down along her neck to her collarbones. Because the load is shared between two openings, each earlobe is stretched only into a firm, moderately long, healthy loop of skin that hangs just past her jaw; the lobe does not sag, droop, collapse or hang down to her shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
